answer: Last close posts r, locked over locked-plus-spendable for the whole network. A first-seen answer counts only after the protocol locks k times r units of last close's median payout until this answer settles, k being first-seen keys already accepted this window including itself. One honest head locks r of that median; the tenth locks 10r, so the next head posts more capital. r cannot be minted, split, or pre-aged, and adding a key raises k. A dune of clones posts a rising shale of lock, and the pigment of the locked share is the meter.
